shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side. A man in a navy blazer occupies the screen-side window seat and introduces the project milestones, while a man in a mustard sweater sits at the screen-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the glass-door end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.

shots.content: A woman in an emerald blouse enters and takes the door-side window seat, asking for an update, and the man in a navy blazer answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a navy blazer clarifies the schedule.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the conference table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.
